elite_manager_timing_sanity.interpretation: Observed strong-manager timing is a behavioural sanity check, not a causal label or a substitute for point-in-time policy replay.

limitations: 2025/26 shares the two-of-each half-season structure; it is applied counterfactually to 2023/24 and 2024/25.
Wildcard and Free Hit have exact live branches but no promoted event-level causal retained-value model.
Prospective 2026/27 receipts remain necessary to establish superiority under current rules.

recency.reason: The current rule regime and football environment are closer to recent seasons; older seasons stabilize only through the chosen half-life.

free_hit.source: exact historical threshold replay; event-level outcome gate rejected
